# cc-to-antigravity-cli-bridge

> Drive Google's Antigravity CLI (agy) from Claude Code for complementary search, subscription-quota use, and light multi-model assist. System-prompt sharing plus a research-method prompt prefix. CLI counterpart to claude-code-antigravity-ide-bridge.

## What this repo does

Antigravity CLI (agy) reaches Gemini Pro/Flash on a Google subscription, plus other models listed by `agy models`. This repo covers driving it from Claude Code:

1. Complementary web research: Gemini often reaches sources that Claude web_search / web_fetch miss under anti-bot
2. Put idle Gemini subscription or student-promo quota to work via `agy -p`
3. Optional Claude Sonnet 4.6 / Opus 4.6 through agy for light assist next to main Claude Code sessions
4. Share the system prompt by symlinking AGENTS.md to CLAUDE.md (agy reads AGENTS.md natively)
5. research-prefix.md: model-agnostic research-method prefix for headless CLIs (agy -p, grok -p, claude -p)
6. scripts/ccagy.sh: prepends the prefix and runs agy -p from a clean temp cwd

## Key facts

- agy runs on the Gemini subscription quota when logged in with Google; setting GEMINI_API_KEY forces API billing instead
- agy -p is the non-interactive one-shot mode; --model takes the exact display name from `agy models`
- Claude Code remains the daily driver; this repo is a complementary lane, not a replacement

## Scope

- As of 2026-07, agy has no memory API and no documented hook schema, so Grok-bridge-style memory sync and hook adapters are out of scope
- Soft rules live in AGENTS.md; per-conversation state under ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/ is not a shared knowledge base

- README.md / README.zh-TW.md / README.zh-CN.md
